title: Hobbies and free time
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a szabadidődről, a hobbijaidról, a sportról és a kulturális programokról kérdez. Válaszolj több mondatban, és mondj konkrét példákat.

questions.q: What do you like doing in your free time?
followUps: How long have you been doing it?

questions.q: How much free time do you have on a normal school day?
Do you do any sport? Do you prefer playing sport or watching it?
What kind of music do you listen to?
followUps: Have you ever been to a concert?

questions.q: When did you last go to the cinema or the theatre? What did you see?
Do you like reading? What was the last book you read?
How much time do you spend online every day? What do you do?
What TV series or YouTube channels do you like? Why?
What did you do last weekend?

usefulPhrases.en: In my free time I usually ...
I've been playing the guitar for three years.
The last film I saw was ...
usefulPhrases.hu: Az utolsó film, amit láttam, a ... volt.

usefulPhrases.en: I spend too much time on my phone.
usefulPhrases.hu: Túl sok időt töltök a telefonomon.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What do you like doing in your free time?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I really like playing the guitar. I usually play for about an hour in the evening, because it helps me forget about school.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How long have you been doing it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I've been playing for about five years. My uncle gave me his old guitar for my thirteenth birthday, and I started taking lessons soon after that.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you do any sport? Do you prefer playing sport or watching it?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I go swimming twice a week. I definitely prefer playing sport to watching it, because I get bored if I just sit in front of the TV for ninety minutes.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you like reading? What was the last book you read?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, but I don't have much time for it during the school year. The last book I read was The Hunger Games. I couldn't put it down, so I finished it in three days.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: What did you do last weekend?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: On Saturday I went to Eger with my family to visit my grandparents, and we walked up to the castle. On Sunday I stayed at home and studied for a history test.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: minden válasz több mondatos, és tartalmaz egy személyes részletet vagy indoklást (a nagybácsi gitárja, az egri kirándulás), így a vizsgázó maga viszi tovább a beszélgetést.
Szókincs: a szabadidő témakörének szavai és kifejezései természetesek (take lessons, go swimming, prefer playing sport to watching it, couldn't put it down).

Nyelvhelyesség: az igeidők pontosak – befejezett folyamatos jelen a „How long …?” kérdésre (I've been playing for about five years), egyszerű múlt a múlt hétvégére (went, walked, stayed) –, és a „prefer … to …” szerkezet is helyes.
Érdemes megtanulni: „it helps me forget about school”, „I definitely prefer playing sport to watching it”, „I couldn't put it down”, „I started taking lessons soon after that”.
